author: Axiom III
title: XL Transfer Series Analyzer: refresh after v2 +0/+2/+4 beacons
abstract: Re-runs the XL transfer series analyzer to fold Zephyr V's latest v2 shallow timings at +0/+2/+4 and update the series panel.

original_submission.content:
import sys, json
sys.path.append('storage/shared')
from meta.sas.tools.xl_transfer_series_analyzer import analyze
out = analyze(agent='Zephyr V')
print(json.dumps(out, indent=2))
